0.6.6.en: New: you can now change how a circadian light, Colour Curve Light or Room-sensing Light controls your lights straight from the device, without opening Repair. New: a Transition choice (Gradual, Balanced or Quick) sets how a circadian light, Colour Curve Light or Room-sensing Light moves between its settings. Circadian lights now blend from one part of the day into the next instead of holding each part and changing near the boundary; existing ones are set to Quick, which is closest to how they behaved before. The values each device shows now have icons. If you choose to set lights before they turn on and no light has been tested for it yet, the device tells you to run the light test in Repair. Lightkeeper now speaks every language Homey does: Dutch, German, French, Italian, Swedish, Norwegian, Spanish, Danish, Russian, Polish, Korean and Arabic, as well as English.
0.6.6.nl: Nieuw: je kunt nu rechtstreeks op het apparaat wijzigen hoe een circadiaans licht, kleurcurvelicht of ruimtebewust licht je lampen bedient, zonder Repareren te openen. Nieuw: met de keuze Overgang (Geleidelijk, Gebalanceerd of Snel) stel je in hoe een circadiaans licht, kleurcurvelicht of ruimtebewust licht tussen zijn instellingen overgaat. Circadiaanse lichten vloeien nu van het ene deel van de dag over in het volgende, in plaats van elk deel vast te houden en vlak bij de grens te wisselen; bestaande staan op Snel, wat het dichtst bij hun oude gedrag komt. De waarden die elk apparaat toont, hebben nu pictogrammen. Als je kiest om lampen in te stellen voordat ze aangaan en er nog geen lamp op is getest, vraagt het apparaat je de lamptest uit te voeren in Repareren. Lightkeeper spreekt nu elke taal die Homey spreekt: Nederlands, Duits, Frans, Italiaans, Zweeds, Noors, Spaans, Deens, Russisch, Pools, Koreaans en Arabisch, naast Engels.
0.6.6.de: Neu: Du kannst jetzt direkt am Gerät ändern, wie ein zirkadianes Licht, Farbkurvenlicht oder raumsensitives Licht deine Lichter steuert, ohne Reparieren zu öffnen. Neu: Mit der Auswahl Übergang (Allmählich, Ausgewogen oder Schnell) legst du fest, wie ein zirkadianes Licht, Farbkurvenlicht oder raumsensitives Licht zwischen seinen Einstellungen wechselt. Zirkadiane Lichter gehen jetzt fließend von einem Teil des Tages in den nächsten über, statt jeden Teil zu halten und kurz vor der Grenze zu wechseln; bestehende sind auf Schnell gestellt, was ihrem bisherigen Verhalten am nächsten kommt. Die Werte, die jedes Gerät anzeigt, haben jetzt Symbole. Wenn du Lichter vor dem Einschalten einstellen lässt und noch kein Licht dafür getestet wurde, weist dich das Gerät darauf hin, den Lichttest in Reparieren auszuführen. Lightkeeper spricht jetzt jede Sprache, die Homey spricht: Niederländisch, Deutsch, Französisch, Italienisch, Schwedisch, Norwegisch, Spanisch, Dänisch, Russisch, Polnisch, Koreanisch und Arabisch, dazu Englisch.
0.6.6.fr: Nouveau : vous pouvez désormais changer la façon dont un éclairage circadien, un éclairage à courbe de couleur ou un éclairage selon la pièce contrôle vos lumières directement depuis l'appareil, sans ouvrir Réparer. Nouveau : un choix de Transition (Progressive, Équilibrée ou Rapide) détermine comment un éclairage circadien, un éclairage à courbe de couleur ou un éclairage selon la pièce passe d'un réglage à l'autre. Les éclairages circadiens passent désormais en douceur d'un moment de la journée au suivant, au lieu de garder chaque moment et de changer près de la limite ; les éclairages existants sont réglés sur Rapide, le plus proche de leur comportement précédent. Les valeurs affichées par chaque appareil ont maintenant des icônes. Si vous choisissez de régler les lumières avant leur allumage et qu'aucune lumière n'a encore été testée pour cela, l'appareil vous invite à lancer le test des lumières dans Réparer. Lightkeeper parle désormais toutes les langues de Homey : néerlandais, allemand, français, italien, suédois, norvégien, espagnol, danois, russe, polonais, coréen et arabe, en plus de l'anglais.
0.6.6.it: Novità: ora puoi cambiare il modo in cui una luce circadiana, una luce a curva di colore o una luce sensibile all'ambiente controlla le tue luci direttamente dal dispositivo, senza aprire Ripara. Novità: una scelta di Transizione (Graduale, Bilanciata o Rapida) stabilisce come una luce circadiana, una luce a curva di colore o una luce sensibile all'ambiente passa da un'impostazione all'altra. Le luci circadiane ora sfumano da una parte della giornata alla successiva invece di mantenere ogni parte e cambiare vicino al confine; quelle esistenti sono impostate su Rapida, la più vicina al loro comportamento precedente. I valori mostrati da ogni dispositivo ora hanno delle icone. Se scegli di impostare le luci prima dell'accensione e nessuna luce è stata ancora testata, il dispositivo ti chiede di eseguire il test delle luci in Ripara. Lightkeeper ora parla tutte le lingue di Homey: olandese, tedesco, francese, italiano, svedese, norvegese, spagnolo, danese, russo, polacco, coreano e arabo, oltre all'inglese.
0.6.6.sv: Nytt: du kan nu ändra hur ett dygnsrytmsljus, färgkurvljus eller rumskännande ljus styr dina lampor direkt från enheten, utan att öppna Reparera. Nytt: ett val för Övergång (Gradvis, Balanserad eller Snabb) bestämmer hur ett dygnsrytmsljus, färgkurvljus eller rumskännande ljus rör sig mellan sina inställningar. Dygnsrytmsljus tonar nu över från en del av dagen till nästa i stället för att hålla varje del och byta nära gränsen; befintliga är inställda på Snabb, som ligger närmast hur de betedde sig tidigare. Värdena som varje enhet visar har nu ikoner. Om du väljer att ställa in lamporna innan de tänds och ingen lampa har testats för det än, ber enheten dig köra lamptestet i Reparera. Lightkeeper talar nu alla språk som Homey gör: nederländska, tyska, franska, italienska, svenska, norska, spanska, danska, ryska, polska, koreanska och arabiska, utöver engelska.
0.6.6.no: Nytt: du kan nå endre hvordan et døgnrytmelys, et Fargekurvelys eller et Romfølende lys styrer lysene dine, rett fra enheten, uten å åpne Reparer. Nytt: et valg for Overgang (Gradvis, Balansert eller Rask) bestemmer hvordan et døgnrytmelys, et Fargekurvelys eller et Romfølende lys beveger seg mellom innstillingene sine. Døgnrytmelys glir nå over fra én del av dagen til den neste i stedet for å holde hver del og skifte nær grensen; eksisterende er satt til Rask, som ligger nærmest hvordan de oppførte seg før. Verdiene hver enhet viser, har nå ikoner. Hvis du velger å stille inn lys før de slås på, og ingen lys er testet for det ennå, ber enheten deg kjøre lystesten under Reparer. Lightkeeper snakker nå alle språkene Homey gjør: nederlandsk, tysk, fransk, italiensk, svensk, norsk, spansk, dansk, russisk, polsk, koreansk og arabisk, i tillegg til engelsk.
0.6.6.es: Novedad: ahora puedes cambiar cómo una luz circadiana, una Luz con curva de color o una Luz que percibe la habitación controla tus luces directamente desde el dispositivo, sin abrir Reparar. Novedad: una opción de Transición (Gradual, Equilibrada o Rápida) define cómo una luz circadiana, una Luz con curva de color o una Luz que percibe la habitación pasa de un ajuste a otro. Las luces circadianas ahora pasan de una parte del día a la siguiente de forma progresiva, en lugar de mantener cada parte y cambiar cerca del límite; las que ya existen quedan en Rápida, que es lo más parecido a como funcionaban antes. Los valores que muestra cada dispositivo ahora tienen iconos. Si eliges ajustar las luces antes de que se enciendan y aún no se ha probado ninguna luz para ello, el dispositivo te pide que hagas la prueba de luces en Reparar. Lightkeeper ahora habla todos los idiomas de Homey: neerlandés, alemán, francés, italiano, sueco, noruego, español, danés, ruso, polaco, coreano y árabe, además de inglés.
0.6.6.da: Nyt: du kan nu ændre, hvordan et døgnrytmelys, et Farvekurvelys eller et Rumfølende lys styrer dine lys, direkte fra enheden uden at åbne Reparér. Nyt: et valg af Overgang (Gradvis, Balanceret eller Hurtig) bestemmer, hvordan et døgnrytmelys, et Farvekurvelys eller et Rumfølende lys bevæger sig mellem sine indstillinger. Døgnrytmelys glider nu over fra én del af dagen til den næste i stedet for at holde hver del og skifte tæt på grænsen; eksisterende er sat til Hurtig, som ligger tættest på, hvordan de opførte sig før. De værdier, hver enhed viser, har nu ikoner. Hvis du vælger at indstille lys, før de tænder, og intet lys er testet til det endnu, beder enheden dig køre lystesten under Reparér. Lightkeeper taler nu alle de sprog, Homey gør: hollandsk, tysk, fransk, italiensk, svensk, norsk, spansk, dansk, russisk, polsk, koreansk og arabisk, foruden engelsk.
0.6.6.ru: Новое: теперь способ, которым циркадный свет, свет по цветовой кривой или свет по освещённости комнаты управляет светильниками, можно изменить прямо на устройстве, не открывая «Восстановить». Новое: выбор перехода (плавный, сбалансированный или быстрый) определяет, как циркадный свет, свет по цветовой кривой или свет по освещённости комнаты переходит от одной настройки к другой. Циркадный свет теперь плавно перетекает из одной части дня в следующую, а не держит каждую часть и не меняется у самой границы; для существующих устройств выбран быстрый переход — он ближе всего к прежнему поведению. У значений, которые показывает каждое устройство, появились значки. Если вы выбрали настройку света до включения, но ни один светильник ещё не проверен, устройство подскажет запустить тест светильников в «Восстановить». Lightkeeper теперь говорит на всех языках Homey: нидерландском, немецком, французском, итальянском, шведском, норвежском, испанском, датском, русском, польском, корейском и арабском, а также на английском.
0.6.6.pl: Nowość: sposób, w jaki światło okołodobowe, światło z krzywą barw lub światło czujące pomieszczenie steruje twoimi światłami, możesz teraz zmienić bezpośrednio na urządzeniu, bez otwierania „Napraw”. Nowość: wybór przejścia (stopniowe, zrównoważone lub szybkie) określa, jak światło okołodobowe, światło z krzywą barw lub światło czujące pomieszczenie przechodzi między swoimi ustawieniami. Światła okołodobowe płynnie przechodzą teraz z jednej części dnia w następną, zamiast trzymać każdą część i zmieniać się tuż przy granicy; istniejące mają ustawione szybkie przejście, najbliższe temu, jak działały wcześniej. Wartości pokazywane przez każde urządzenie mają teraz ikony. Jeśli wybierzesz ustawianie świateł przed włączeniem, a żadne światło nie zostało jeszcze do tego przetestowane, urządzenie poprosi o uruchomienie testu świateł w „Napraw”. Lightkeeper mówi teraz we wszystkich językach Homey: niderlandzkim, niemieckim, francuskim, włoskim, szwedzkim, norweskim, hiszpańskim, duńskim, rosyjskim, polskim, koreańskim i arabskim, a także po angielsku.
0.6.6.ko: 새 기능: 이제 복구를 열지 않고도 기기에서 바로 생체리듬 조명, 색상 곡선 조명, 실내 감지 조명이 조명을 제어하는 방법을 바꿀 수 있어요. 새 기능: 전환 옵션(천천히, 균형, 빠르게)으로 생체리듬 조명, 색상 곡선 조명, 실내 감지 조명이 설정 사이를 어떻게 옮겨 갈지 정할 수 있어요. 생체리듬 조명은 이제 하루의 각 부분을 유지하다가 경계 근처에서 바뀌는 대신 다음 부분으로 자연스럽게 이어져요. 기존 조명은 이전 동작에 가장 가까운 빠르게로 설정돼요. 각 기기에 표시되는 값에 이제 아이콘이 있어요. 조명이 켜지기 전에 설정하도록 선택했는데 아직 테스트한 조명이 없으면, 기기가 복구에서 조명 테스트를 실행하라고 알려 줘요. 이제 Lightkeeper는 영어뿐 아니라 네덜란드어, 독일어, 프랑스어, 이탈리아어, 스웨덴어, 노르웨이어, 스페인어, 덴마크어, 러시아어, 폴란드어, 한국어, 아랍어까지 Homey가 지원하는 모든 언어를 사용해요.
0.6.6.ar: جديد: يمكنك الآن تغيير طريقة تحكم إضاءة الإيقاع اليومي أو إضاءة منحنى الألوان أو الإضاءة التي تستشعر الغرفة بأضوائك مباشرة من الجهاز، دون فتح الإصلاح. جديد: خيار الانتقال (تدريجي أو متوازن أو سريع) يحدد كيف تنتقل إضاءة الإيقاع اليومي أو إضاءة منحنى الألوان أو الإضاءة التي تستشعر الغرفة بين إعداداتها. أصبحت إضاءة الإيقاع اليومي تنتقل بسلاسة من جزء من اليوم إلى الجزء التالي بدلًا من الثبات على كل جزء ثم التغير قرب الحد الفاصل؛ وقد ضُبطت الأجهزة الحالية على سريع، وهو الأقرب إلى سلوكها السابق. أصبحت للقيم التي يعرضها كل جهاز أيقونات. إذا اخترت ضبط الأضواء قبل تشغيلها ولم يُختبر أي ضوء لذلك بعد، فسيطلب منك الجهاز تشغيل اختبار الأضواء في الإصلاح. أصبح Lightkeeper يتحدث كل لغة يتحدثها Homey: الهولندية والألمانية والفرنسية والإيطالية والسويدية والنرويجية والإسبانية والدنماركية والروسية والبولندية والكورية والعربية، إلى جانب الإنجليزية.

0.6.5.en: New: you now choose on the last setup screen how Lightkeeper controls your lights. If a device used to set colours before lights turn on, run the new light test once from Repair to turn that back on. A remote button can now turn lights on with the colour and brightness your other Lightkeeper devices want, and those values can be used in your own Flows. The setup screens have been redrawn, and lights no longer get left alone for hours when nobody touched them.

0.6.0.en: A fifth kind of device. A Room-sensing Light sets your lights' brightness from how much light is in the room already, dimming them as the morning comes up and lifting them again as it goes — or the other way round if you would rather the room followed the day. It works out how light it is from a light sensor you already own, and most motion sensors have one, or from how high the sun is using your Homey's own location. It needs no API key, only dims lights that are already on, and never switches one on or off. Every setup screen has also been redrawn: one question at a time, and a review of everything before it saves. Circadian lights now describe three parts of the day, with the boundaries following your own sunrise and sunset through the year instead of a fixed clock. On a Light Remote, each button can drive its own lights. Also fixed: a light that quietly returns to its own settings after Lightkeeper changes it is no longer mistaken for you taking over by hand, which could leave that light alone for days. Finally, three device types are renamed: Light controller to Light Remote, Curve light to Colour Curve Light, and Daylight light to Room-sensing Light. Only the names change — devices you have already added keep working, keep the name you gave them, and keep their settings and Flows.

0.5.2.en: Four fixes, all on the light-following device types. A Curve light could keep the colour it last held instead of going back to white: a curve that mixes coloured points with plain warmth points switched correctly the first time and then stopped switching back, because the lamp was never told to leave colour mode. The dimmest brightness setting no longer means off, either. Five per cent worked out to nothing at the lamp once converted, so lights set that low went dark rather than dim; the lowest setting is now ten per cent, and any curve point, schedule or circadian light already set below that has been moved up to it. Blends between two colours far apart on the wheel, amber to ocean say, now fade through pale instead of swinging round through purple and magenta on the way; colours close together look the same as they always did. And a bug report now says which of a curve's points carry a colour and what colour each light was last sent, none of which it could tell you before.

0.5.1.en: A tidier App Store listing. The description is much shorter and gets to the point, this What's new section reads as a paragraph instead of a wall of markup, and the four device icons have been redrawn so they are legible in the small circle the store draws them in. Nothing about how the app works has changed.

0.5.0.en: New: a Curve light, which is the circadian light with the whole day open to you. Set what your lights should look like at every point you choose, and give any of those points a colour instead of a warmth, from candle and amber through to ocean and forest. Lights that cannot show a colour follow the warmth instead, so the day looks the same shape on every lamp. The circadian light is simpler now: it asks two questions, what your lights should look like at their warmest and at their coolest, and handles the rest of the day itself. An existing circadian light keeps those two points and drops the ones in between; nothing stops working and nothing needs setting up again, and a curve you want back is a Curve light away. Also fixed: two schedules whose times overlap on the same lights no longer fight, a schedule refuses to run rather than guess the day when it cannot read your Homey's timezone, a remote whose buttons and dial share one Flow card now gets one Flow per button and direction, every screen stays light even when your phone is set to dark mode, and Lightkeeper uses less memory on your Homey.

0.4.0.en: New: a circadian light. Pick your lights, set how warm they should be through the day, and they follow it: the right colour the moment they come on, and adjusted while they stay on. It never switches lights on or off, and it needs no API key. Optionally follows brightness too, and can set the colour before the lights come on. Change a light by hand and it leaves that light alone until you switch it off and on again.

0.3.1.en: Generated Flows are now grouped in a folder per device, inside the Lightkeeper folder, so it is obvious which Flows came from which controller or schedule. Rename a device and its folder follows; delete it and the folder goes too. Flows made before this update move themselves the next time the device checks in, except any you had moved into a folder of your own, which stay exactly where you put them. The device type for remotes is now called Light controller instead of Remote-to-light controller, and nothing else changes: your existing devices, mappings and Flows are untouched.

0.3.0.en: New look. The app has a new icon, new colours taken from it, and new pictures for both device types, including a proper timer for the schedule device. Every screen in the app now uses the new colours. Fixed: a pairing or repair screen no longer waits forever when Homey does not answer, so you can try again instead of watching a screen that never finishes, and when a remote turns out to offer no usable events, a bug report now lists the trigger cards that were considered and why each was turned down.

0.2.2.en: New artwork throughout. The app icon is a lighthouse now, which suits the name better than the old remote-and-bulb, and the two device icons are drawn to match it. The app's picture in the store shows lamps lit in an evening room instead of a hand holding a remote, because the app does more than remotes, and the schedule device now has a picture of a lamp rather than a drawing of a clock face.

0.2.1.en: Fixed: warm and cold were the wrong way round. A schedule set to the warmest setting lit the room cold white, and on a remote the warmer button made the light colder. Both now go the way they say. If you set a warmth on a schedule before this update, open it and check the setting still reads the way you want it.

0.2.0.en: New: light schedules. Add a schedule device, pick your lights, and say when they come on and when they go off, after a while or at a set time. Up to twelve schedules per device, on the days you choose, optionally at a brightness and warmth you set. Each schedule device has its own switch, so you can pause the whole thing while you are away without losing any of it. The app is now called Lightkeeper, because it does more than link a remote to a light. Editing a generated Flow by hand is also noticed in more cases now, including changing the time on one: Lightkeeper leaves your edit alone and asks you to repair instead of quietly overwriting it.

0.1.0.en: First release. Point a paired remote, switch, button or rotary dial at your lights, and control on/off, brightness and colour temperature across individual lights or whole zones. Lightkeeper creates and maintains the Flows behind each mapping for you. Connects locally, for Homey Pro 2023 and later.

0.1.1.en: Fixed: repair now opens. It failed with an internal file error before any screen appeared, so a controller that needed repair had no way to be fixed. Giving a button a job another button already had now says so next to both controls; the notice used to sit at the bottom of the screen, below every light, where nobody saw it, and the control that lost its job quietly went back to Not assigned. App settings now show the API key status in colour: green when a working key is saved, amber when none is saved yet, red when a saved key has stopped working.
